div.div: Decompose a → a_G (gravitational, head tilt) + a_nG (non-gravitational, motion) via AHRS (Extended Kalman Filter).
Extract features on each CPD segment (median ~377 ms).
Energy: RMS, mean absolute value, Euclidean norm
Per-segment average pitch, roll (von Mises-Fisher centroid)
Change in head azimuth (heading difference, start-to-end)
Band-limited power: 5–7 Hz (trotting), 8.5–11 Hz (sniffing), 16–20 Hz (wet dog shake)
Peak frequency & spectral centroid per axis
Band ratios (target band / full band / neighboring bands)
Cross-correlation: ω_x vs ω_z (grooming signature), a_nG,x vs a_nG,z
Correlation between angular velocity and linear acceleration axes
Head-motion direction relative to gravity vector
Variable-length native: computed on CPD segments, not fixed windows.
Time-frequency complementary: time-domain stats capture intensity; CWT captures rhythmic signatures (sniffing, gait).
Direction-sensitive: cross-axis coupling distinguishes kinematically similar but geometrically distinct behaviors (e.g., grooming vs. orienting).
